traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Wikipedia, Polypodiaceae (read 2026-10-16): fronds borne singly along an upright to long-creeping scaly rhizome; never paired at a node (our general knowledge for the rest of the order).

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: Wikipedia, Polypodiaceae (read 2026-10-16): stems from erect to long-creeping. Erect and short-creeping rhizomes carry fronds all round (spiral); long-creeping dorsiventral rhizomes (Polypodium, Davallia, Pteridium) often in two rows. Weighting is our inference, medium confidence.

traits.division_pattern.note: Wikipedia, Polypodiaceae (read 2026-10-16): fronds simple, pinnatifid, forked or pinnate; across the order divided fronds are overwhelmingly pinnate (one to several times). Palmate/pedate fronds are rare exceptions.

traits.leaf_division.note: Wikipedia, Polypodiaceae (read 2026-10-16): simple to compound fronds; most of the order pinnate.

traits.life_span.note: Wikipedia, Polypodiaceae (read 2026-10-16): perennial rhizomatous ferns; a few short-lived Pteridaceae (Anogramma, Ceratopteris) are exceptions.
